schema_version: 1
layers:
  domain: internal/domain
  usecase: internal/usecase
  transport: internal/transport
  infrastructure: internal/infrastructure
  composition_root: cmd/ms-go-auth
ownership:
  auth: [credentials, verification proofs, auth identities, OAuth transactions, JWT issuance and verification, refresh sessions]
  external: [user profiles, roles and permissions, verification-code delivery]
invariants:
  - OAuth state is one-time and PKCE-protected.
  - Refresh rotation revokes the consumed session before issuing a replacement.
  - Password and token secrets never cross response or logging boundaries.
  - Domain and usecase depend on ports, never transport, infrastructure, or GORM.
